Name: Better Fruit Juice (EBAGI pack for vanilla fruit juices)
Author: LilietBorodina
AuthorLabel: coded by Liliet - art credit to cometkins and SHYZIIE
Description:
Q: What does this mod add?
A: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins?gameId=1303]Better[/url]-style textures for juices made from vanilla fruit.

Q: How do I get fruit juice?
A: Up to you. I personally got it from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22991]Additional Tree Equipments[/url] (which lets you tap giant crops) combined with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url] (which lets more stuff turn into giant crops). You probably can't get _every_ fruit juice from there, but this mod adds juice textures for all vanilla fruit.

Q: How do I install it?
A: Just drop it into your mod manager / mod folder / do the mod manager download. It'a content pack with manifest and everything.

Q: How the fuck did you make this???
A: Fruit are vegetables now! Yeah, I can't believe this worked either. (Secretly, "fruit", "vegetables" and other labels in the data.json file just mean input for which artisan good category they are, they don't have to actually be those)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23366]Shoutout also to the vanilla BAG EBAGI mod I published earlier (also with Shyziie's art), now a proper content pack!!!![/url]

Manifest.Name: Better Fruit Juice
Manifest.Description: Adds Better style icons for vanilla fruit juices for EBAGI
Manifest.Author: coded by Liliet, art by cometkins and SHYZIIE!!!
